newsitem.title: FINLAND: Silja rallies on debt-for-equity swap.
newsitem.headline: Silja rallies on debt-for-equity swap.

text.p: Shares in Finnish passenger ferry operator Silja Oy Ab rose in lively trade on Friday after the group announced on Thursday plans to improve its capital structure through a debt-for-equity swap, brokers said.

At 1125 GMT, Silja's more liquid A share traded at 35.50 markka, up 3.50 markka or almost 11 percent, after hitting 36.10 markka -- its highest since September 24. Trade was lively with volume reaching 7.9 million markka.
"The swap will help Silja to reduce its financing costs," one broker said. @
Heavily indebted Silja on Thursday proposed to redeem its outstanding debentures and issue new shares to lift its equity to assets ratio, which was at 10.5 percent at the end of September.
